Name: Pyromancer's Journey
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Pyromancer's Journey[/b] adds a new Doom-style arcade game.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
You can start the journey by interacting with the arcade machine in the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Volcano_Dungeon]Volcano Dungeon[/url] shop.

Press [font=Courier New]W[/font]/[font=Courier New]S[/font]/[font=Courier New]Q[/font]/[font=Courier New]E[/font] to move, [font=Courier New]A[/font]/[font=Courier New]D[/font] to turn, [font=Courier New]space[/font] to charge your staff and release to shoot. Beat the game to win a prize!

You can also start the game by running the [font=Courier New]pyrojourney[/font] command in the SMAPI console.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
